retrievalProfile.description: A central glowing humanoid figure with visible chakra points set against a large celestial sphere and deep space background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, golden-outlined humanoid figure in a spread-eagle 'Vitruvian' pose, centered within a massive glowing orange-red sphere. Seven colorful chakra symbols are aligned vertically along the figure's spine, connected by a white energy aura. The background is a deep blue and red cosmic void with distant planets.
coreVisualRelationships: Humanoid figure centered within a large circular celestial body
Vertical alignment of chakra symbols along the central axis
Contrast between warm orange-red sphere and cool deep blue space
Typography positioned at the top edge, spanning the width
coreInvariants: The figure must maintain a symmetrical, outstretched pose.
Chakra symbols must be vertically stacked in spectral order.
A glowing white energy 'eight' or aura must surround the torso.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The humanoid figure is the central focus, scaled to fit within the inner 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white energy column and chakra symbols at the center of the figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top typography down the central energy column, then outward to the figure's limbs and the surrounding planets.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep space corners provide negative space, emphasizing the central circular composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep orange and red for the central sphere and lower nebula.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Midnight blue for the upper background space.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold for the typography and figure outline; multi-color for the chakras.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central sphere with high value glows against a dark, low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized with a fluid, calligraphic curve.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and brand consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions with a modern, sharp finish.
The industry standard for cinematic and epic serif displays.
Humanist qualities that bridge the gap between serif and sans.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cosmic scene with a large glowing orange-red sun-like sphere in the center. Inside the sphere, place a golden-outlined humanoid figure in a Vitruvian pose. Add seven glowing chakra symbols vertically along the figure's center, connected by a white energy aura. The background should be deep blue space with small distant planets.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the title in a wide-tracked, all-caps gold serif font at the top of the frame, ensuring a metallic beveled effect.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly seven chakra symbols?
Is the typography in a gold serif font?
Is the background a mix of deep blue and red space?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the figure's golden outline
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact facial features if present
Ensure chakra symbols are generic geometric representations

mustAchieve: Luminous quality in the energy centers

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of chakras
Verify gold metallic texture on text
Ensure the central sphere has a soft outer glow
Confirm the Vitruvian pose is symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure + Celestial sphere + Vertical energy centers + Top-aligned serif typography
